@graph.name: FHIR R4 JSON
@graph.description: The Cascade Bridge Adapter for FHIR R4 JSON: the package of data a Cascade Bridge runs to turn FHIR R4 resources, alone or as the entries of a Bundle, into Cascade records. Import-only. This crate is the adapter's manifest: a Bridge reads the root entity first, for the format id, the source media type, the source schema, the two envelopes, the detect rule, the document table queries, the mappings, the findings queries and the table they read, the profile the Bridge must offer, the vocabulary repository and the paths, in it, of the ontology and shapes files the adapter is read against, the gap scheme every finding takes its body from, each gap declaring the sh:resultSeverity its findings carry where that is not sh:Info, the source accounting, and the test manifest. The data entities carry provenance for every committed file, and a sha256 computed locally over the committed bytes of each digested one. Twenty-seven inputs are copied byte for byte from the conformance repository's fixtures/clinical-fhir and three from its fixtures/genomics/fhir-genomics-ig, at the commit isBasedOn names; the others are authored here, and each says so.

@graph.name: bundle
@graph.description: A Bundle: each entry is a record, so its fullUrl stays with its resource; docs/format.md, "The two envelopes".

@graph.name: resource
@graph.description: A resource alone: the document is the record.

@graph.name: sparql-1.1
@graph.description: Declared in the Cascade Bridge Specification's vocabulary, vocab/bridge.ttl in cascade-bridge-spec.

@graph.name: Cascade Bridge Adapter profile
@graph.description: The RO-Crate 1.2 Profile Crate a conforming adapter package names in conformsTo; the Profile Crate describing it is adapter/profile/ro-crate-metadata.json in cascade-bridge-spec.

@graph.name: cascade-vocabulary
@graph.description: The repository the adapter's vocabularies are read from, at the version a run picks; the paths in bridge:vocabularyFile are read there, and each of those ontology files is licensed Apache-2.0 AND CC-BY-4.0. A web-based data entity, referenced and not committed: the RO-Crate 1.2 validator reads every SoftwareSourceCode as a script that must be a File in hasPart.

@graph.name: Cascade vocabulary
@graph.description: The vocabulary the adapter writes, as cascade-vocabulary declares it.

@graph.name: FHIR R4 JSON Schema, pinned copy
@graph.description: HL7's JSON Schema for FHIR R4, pinned byte for byte: the source schema every record is validated against. Identical to the file at the isBasedOn URL on 2026-09-27; sha256 is computed locally over the committed bytes. Never edited; to change it, replace it from its source and update contentSize and sha256 in the same commit.

@graph.name: FHIR R4 JSON Schema
@graph.description: HL7's published JSON Schema for FHIR R4 (4.0.1), draft-06, its id http://hl7.org/fhir/json-schema/4.0. Downloaded over HTTPS on 2026-09-27; dateModified is the HTTPS Last-Modified. HL7 publishes no digest beside it; the copy inside fhir.schema.json.zip on the same site, read the same day, has the same sha256.

@graph.name: Detect rule
@graph.description: The detect rule, bridge:detectQuery: an ASK over the envelope skeleton, true for a JSON document whose value is a FHIR resource, a Bundle among them.

@graph.name: Document table
@graph.description: A bridge:documentTableQuery: for each record, where it stands and its resource's type, id and fullUrl, so record.rq tells an id or a urn:uuid the document repeats and resolves a reference to another record of the document.

@graph.name: Document table: which Observations are lab results
@graph.description: A bridge:documentTableQuery: a row for each Observation of a record that is a lab result, wherever it stands, by its category, or, where it has none, by a LOINC code no vital sign of vocab/fhir-vital-signs.ttl carries, a panel and a Variant or Diagnostic Implication of the Genomics Reporting IG excluded; record.rq, lab-result.rq and the findings queries ask it whether one is.

@graph.name: Document table: which Observations are variants
@graph.description: A bridge:documentTableQuery: a row for each Observation of a record coded LOINC 69548-6, wherever it stands, and not by its profile: fhirr4:variantAt where its value is Present (LA9633-4) or it has none, fhirr4:variantNotPresentAt where it has another value. record.rq, variant.rq and the findings queries ask it whether one is a variant record.

@graph.name: Document table: which Observations are diagnostic implications
@graph.description: A bridge:documentTableQuery: a row, fhirr4:interpretationAt, for each Observation of a record coded diagnostic-implication in the Genomics Reporting IG's tbd-codes-cs, wherever it stands, and not by its profile; record.rq, variant-interpretation.rq and the findings queries ask it whether one is a variant interpretation record.

@graph.name: Document table: Medications, references to them, and their keys
@graph.description: A bridge:documentTableQuery: a row for each key a Medication of a record can be referenced by, within the scope it holds there, with the Medication's name and a row for each of its codings, its system and code as written, and a row for each reference of a medication or a MedicationDispense, the key it names and that key's scope, a version stripped; medication.rq, medication-findings.rq and resource-type-findings.rq each resolve a reference by joining them, to the one Medication holding its key in its scope.

@graph.name: Document table: Organizations, the document references naming them, and their keys
@graph.description: A bridge:documentTableQuery: a row for each key an Organization of a record can be referenced by, within the scope it holds there; a row for each custodian and author reference of the document's Composition, the first entry of a Bundle or one standing alone, the key it names, that key's scope and the role, and for each performer reference of a Diagnostic Implication, with no role, a version stripped; and a row for each Organization from a server, one at the top of an entry with an id and a fullUrl that is no urn:uuid where the server is known, with its id, and for each other Organization with an identifier it can be named by, that identifier, picked as cascade-vocabulary's decisions/naming.md says, and its place in the document. And a row for each name, identifier and address an Organization's version would carry, which organization-findings.rq compares. organization.rq and resource-type-findings.rq resolve a reference by joining them, to the one Organization holding its key in its scope.

@graph.name: Document table: which DocumentReference is a note or document
@graph.description: One row per DocumentReference that is a note or document record: every one but one whose content's format is a structured C-CDA document (urn:hl7-org:sdwg:ccda-structuredBody:, in HL7's document format codes or the IHE format codes), which is a source of its own; an unstructured one (ccda-nonXMLBody:) is a note.

@graph.name: Document table query: the system each written Coding.system is read as
@graph.description: One row for each system the record writes, named by the system as written, and the system a mapping reads it as: the cascade:codingSystemUri of the concept of vocab/fhir-code-systems.ttl whose skos:notation is its OID after urn:oid: (the prefix in any case) or whose skos:hiddenLabel is it, a URI HL7 Terminology lists as not preferred; else urn:oid: and the OID, or the system as written. A system that is no absolute URI, or holds a space or a character an IRI may not, has no row, and no code of it is carried. So one code from this adapter and from the C-CDA adapter is one term (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/290).

@graph.name: Mapping: records, versions and arrivals
@graph.description: For each resource of a mapped type, the record's own and each it contains: the record, named by one of cascade-vocabulary's naming rules, its hashed text written as the rule's body in tests/vectors/naming writes it: RecordFromServerNamingRule from the server, type and id where the id is the only one of its type in the document, ContainedRecordNamingRule from the container's name, its meta.versionId, else its meta.lastUpdated, else nothing, and the local id, and RecordFromDocumentNamingRule from the document and the resource's selector otherwise; its class, its source URL where its name has one, and its source id where its class has a predicate for one; its version, the patient the version is about, and the version's arrival with the resource's meta.versionId and meta.lastUpdated, and a contained resource's selector. An Observation is a lab result, a cascade:GeneticVariantFinding or a cascade:VariantInterpretation, and a DocumentReference a cascade:ClinicalNoteOrDocument, by the document table that holds its pointer; a MedicationDispense is a cascade:MedicationDispense; a DiagnosticReport is always a cascade:DiagnosticReport.

@graph.name: Mapping: an AllergyIntolerance's version
@graph.description: What an AllergyIntolerance says, written on the version record.rq names: allergen, allergen codes, clinical and verification status, type, criticality, category, onset, reactions, their codes and severity, and notes.

@graph.name: Mapping: a Condition's version
@graph.description: What a Condition says, written on the version record.rq names: name, every code, SNOMED CT and ICD-10-CM as IRIs and any other system's, ICD-9-CM's among them, as cascade:conditionCodeInOtherSystem literals typed by the system coding-system-table.rq reads (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/290), clinical and verification status, category, onset, abatement and notes.

@graph.name: Mapping: an Immunization's version
@graph.description: What an Immunization says, written on the version record.rq names: vaccine name, each CVX code as an IRI, date, status, lot number, dose, route, site and notes.

@graph.name: Mapping: a Procedure's version
@graph.description: What a Procedure says, written on the version record.rq names: name, every code, SNOMED CT as IRIs, the first CPT code as a cascade:cptCode IRI under https://ns.cascadeprotocol.org/codes/cpt/, and any other system's, HCPCS's among them, as cascade:procedureCodeInOtherSystem literals typed by the system coding-system-table.rq reads (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/290), date and status.

@graph.name: Mapping: a Patient's version
@graph.description: What a Patient says, written on the version record.rq names: the first name it states, its birth date, its gender where it is one of the four codes of administrative-gender, and its death: cascade:deceased from deceasedBoolean, and a deceasedDateTime as the date of death with cascade:deceased true.

@graph.name: Mapping: a MedicationRequest's or MedicationStatement's version
@graph.description: What a medication says, written on the version record.rq names: whether it was prescribed or reported, prescribed for a request unless its reported[x] says it was reported, and reportedUse for a statement or such a request; a prescribed request's intent, where it is one of the eight codes of medicationrequest-intent (cascade:medicationRequestIntent); the drug's name and every code, from its concept or from the Medication its reference resolves to in the document, else the reference's display: RxNorm and NDC as IRIs, the first userSelected one the selected code, and any other system's as cascade:medicationCodeInOtherSystem literals typed by the system coding-system-table.rq reads (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/290); status, start and end dates of use, the day a request was written, never a start, and the first dosage's text. Its supply and dosages are medication-supply-and-dosages.rq's. A MedicationDispense's drug, codes and status are read alike and nothing else of this is; medication-dispense.rq reads the rest.

@graph.name: Mapping: a medication's supply and the structure of its dosages
@graph.description: On the version medication.rq writes (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/299): a request's cascade:courseOfTherapyType (a code of FHIR's medicationrequest-course-of-therapy), cascade:numberOfRepeatsAllowed (0 included), cascade:expectedSupplyDuration (a quantity node <version>#expected-supply-duration, only in one of UCUM's seven units of time, with its comparator where it is one of R4's four) and cascade:dispenseValidityPeriodStart and End; and for every dosage, a request's dosageInstruction or a statement's dosage, a cascade:structuredDosage node <version>#dosage-n whatever it holds, with its first dose quantity (<version>#dosage-n-dose-quantity), its timing's cascade:dosageRepeatFrequency, cascade:dosageRepeatPeriod and cascade:dosageRepeatPeriodUnit, its bounds period's start and end, and every route code, SNOMED CT's as cascade:dosageRouteCode IRIs and any other system's as cascade:dosageRouteCodeInOtherSystem literals. Numbers are written as written and as canonical xsd:decimal values; dates are typed by their precision, a time to the minute padded with a cascade:PaddedDateTime node.

@graph.name: Mapping: a MedicationDispense's times and amounts
@graph.description: On the version medication.rq writes (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/300): a dispense's cascade:dispensePreparedTime and cascade:dispenseHandedOverTime, typed by their precision, a time to the minute padded with a cascade:PaddedDateTime node; its quantity dispensed (cascade:dispenseQuantity, a quantity node <version>#dispense-quantity) and its days' supply (cascade:dispenseDaysSupply, <version>#dispense-days-supply, only in one of UCUM's seven units of time). A number is written as written and as a canonical xsd:decimal; a quantity with a comparator is none.

@graph.name: Mapping: the prescriptions a MedicationDispense names
@graph.description: Each authorizingPrescription of a MedicationDispense that names a MedicationRequest record, by a urn:uuid one entry holds, by MedicationRequest/<id> on the dispense's server or its absolute URL there, whatever the dispense's fullUrl is, or by "#" and the id of a MedicationRequest its record contains, as that record's IRI under cascade:authorizingPrescription on the dispense's version.

@graph.name: Mapping: an Organization a document names
@graph.description: An Organization the document's Composition names as custodian or author, or a Diagnostic Implication names as its performer, as a record named by cascade:OrganizationNamingRule from the identifier organization-table.rq picks, with one version of each record, from the Organization a custodian names, else the first in the document, carrying its name, identifiers and addresses, and the document's prov:qualifiedAttribution naming it once in each role, cascade:CustodianRole or cascade:AuthorRole.

@graph.name: Mapping: an Organization from a server
@graph.description: An Organization at the top of an entry of a document whose server is known, with an id and a fullUrl that is no urn:uuid, as a record named by cascade:OrganizationNamingRule from the server and its id, unless another entry holds an Organization with that id; its version carries its name, identifiers and addresses as organization.rq writes them, its arrival its version id and change time, the record its cascade:sourceUrl and cascade:sourceRecordId as record.rq writes them, and the document's prov:qualifiedAttribution names it once in each role a Composition gives it.

@graph.name: Mapping: a lab result's version
@graph.description: What a lab result says, written on the version record.rq names: test name, the kind of its value (quantity, ratio, range, coded or text), a coded value's SNOMED CT and LOINC codes and its text, a text value, the first reference range as text, performed time, notes and status; its numbers are lab-result-quantities.rq's, its test codes and interpretations lab-result-codes.rq's.

@graph.name: Mapping: a lab result's test codes and interpretation flags
@graph.description: Every coding of a lab result's code, on the version record.rq names: one in LOINC or SNOMED CT as a cascade:testCode IRI, one in any other system as a cascade:testCodeInOtherSystem literal typed by the system coding-system-table.rq reads (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/290); and every flag of every interpretation in HL7's v3 ObservationInterpretation as a cascade:resultInterpretationCode IRI under https://ns.cascadeprotocol.org/codes/observationinterpretation/, the code as written, case kept (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/298). Each in its own branch, so that one does not multiply the others; a code is trimmed of leading and trailing whitespace.

@graph.name: Mapping: the numbers of a lab result's version
@graph.description: Each number a lab result states, as a cascade:Quantity node of the version record.rq names, <version>#<role>: a valueQuantity's or valueInteger's value, a valueRatio's numerator and denominator, a valueRange's low and high, and the low and high of the one reference range whose type is normal, or of the only one; each with its number as written and as a canonical xsd:decimal, its comparator if one of FHIR R4's four, its unit's display, and its unit's code where its system is UCUM. A bound carrying a comparator is not written.

@graph.name: Mapping: a value absent for a stated reason
@graph.description: A value FHIR says is absent, and why, as a cascade:ValueAbsentForReason node of the version record.rq names, <version>#absent-<property>: a lab result's dataAbsentReason for its value (cascade:resultValueKind), where it has none, and the data-absent-reason extension on a mapped date's (a MedicationDispense's included) or a Patient's gender's _element, where the value is absent; each reason the code's IRI in FHIR's data absent reasons or v3 NullFlavor, only a code its CodeSystem defines.

@graph.name: Mapping: the business identifiers of a lab result's version
@graph.description: Each business identifier of a lab result as dct:identifier of its version: its value typed by its system, the NPI's OID as its URI, a urn:oid: system or urn:ietf:rfc:3986 value in lower case urn:oid:, a urn:uuid: system or urn:ietf:rfc:3986 value in lower case, as the C-CDA adapter writes one; a plain string where it states no system or one that is no absolute URI.

@graph.name: Mapping: the organization a lab result from a server names as its performer
@graph.description: A lab result from a server whose performers name exactly one Organization, by Organization/<id> or the server's base and that, as prov:wasAttributedTo of its version: the record cascade:OrganizationNamingRule names from the server and the id, whether or not the document holds it; none from an entry whose fullUrl is a urn:uuid, or for an Organization held under one or under an id two entries hold.

@graph.name: Mapping: a variant's version
@graph.description: What a variant says, written on the version record.rq names: the c.HGVS expression in its normal form, the ClinVar variation ID as digits, the gene symbol and the status. Each is written only where the variant states it once.

@graph.name: Mapping: a variant interpretation's version
@graph.description: What a diagnostic implication says, written on the version record.rq names: the ACMG/AMP classification its classification component's LOINC answer maps to through vocab/fhir-acmg-classifications.ttl, the record of the one variant its derivedFrom names, the day it was issued or else took effect, the status, and prov:wasAttributedTo the organization record of the one Organization its performers name, as organization-table.rq resolves them and organization.rq, or organization-from-server.rq for an Organization from a server, names it.

@graph.name: Mapping: a DiagnosticReport's version
@graph.description: A DiagnosticReport's name, code codings (LOINC and SNOMED CT as cascade:reportCode IRIs, any other system as cascade:reportCodeInOtherSystem literals), each category coding as a literal typed by its system, conclusion, conclusion codes, status and effective time, typed by its precision and padded when written to the minute.

@graph.name: Mapping: the result records a DiagnosticReport names
@graph.description: Each result of a DiagnosticReport that names a lab result, variant or diagnostic implication record, by a urn:uuid one entry holds, by Observation/<id> on the report's server or its absolute URL there, whatever the report's fullUrl is, or by "#" and the id of an Observation its record contains, as that record's IRI under obo:RO_0002351 on the report's version.

@graph.name: Mapping: a DocumentReference's version
@graph.description: A note or document's type codings (LOINC as cascade:noteOrDocumentType IRIs, any other system as literals), type name, description as its title, status, docStatus, date, typed by its precision and padded when written to the minute, and masterIdentifier as cascade:noteOrDocumentMasterIdentifier, typed by its system as the C-CDA adapter writes a ClinicalDocument/id.

@graph.name: Mapping: a report's or a note's attachments
@graph.description: Each presentedForm of a DiagnosticReport and each content attachment of a note or document as a node <version>#attachment-n, n its 1-based position, with its content type, title and URL.

@graph.name: Mapping: a report's or a note's text
@graph.description: A report's or a note's cascade:narrativeText: its first text/plain or text/html attachment's text the Bridge decodes from base64 that holds more than white space, else its narrative div, HTML stripped of its markup, a line per block, entities and their numeric references read.

@graph.name: Mapping: the organization a report's performer or a note's author names
@graph.description: A report from a server whose performers, or a note whose authors, name exactly one Organization, by Organization/<id> or the server's base and that, as prov:wasAttributedTo of its version, as lab-result-performer.rq attributes a lab result.

@graph.name: Findings: a resource of a type this release does not map
@graph.description: A finding for each resource, the record's own or one it contains, whose type is not one of the types this release maps.

@graph.name: Findings: a document of a FHIR version other than R4
@graph.description: A finding for each record of a document whose supplied cascade:sourceFormatVersion is not an R4 version; the mappings write nothing for it.

@graph.name: Findings: an id the document repeats
@graph.description: A finding for each record whose resource's type and id, or whose urn:uuid fullUrl, another record of the document holds too, so record.rq names it from the document and its selector; an Organization from a server among them is no record.

@graph.name: Findings: a recorded date
@graph.description: A finding for each AllergyIntolerance or Condition that states the date it was recorded, which no Cascade predicate carries.

@graph.name: Findings: a date no mapping can type
@graph.description: A finding for each date of a patient, allergy, condition, immunization, procedure, document reference, diagnostic report, laboratory result or interpretation that matches none of the forms of FHIR's date and dateTime, as the mappings test it, so its mapping writes no value.

@graph.name: Findings: a patient's gender
@graph.description: A finding for each Patient whose gender is not one of the four codes of FHIR's administrative gender, which patient.rq does not carry.

@graph.name: Findings: a reference's display
@graph.description: A finding for each patient, subject, reason, result or authorizing prescription reference of a mapped resource that carries a display string, which no Cascade predicate carries.

@graph.name: Findings: an Observation that is not a lab result
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:observationNotLabResult for each Observation lab-result-table.rq does not call a lab result, and that is no variant and no diagnostic implication, at what decided it: a category, a vital sign's LOINC code, the type of one with neither category nor LOINC code, or a panel's members.

@graph.name: Findings: what a medication's mapping leaves behind
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:medicationReferenceUnresolved for a medication's reference that resolves to no one Medication of its document, fhirr4:medicationNote for a medication's note, fhirr4:codingNotCarried for each coding with no system, a system coding-system-table.rq gives no row, or no code, fhirr4:ndcNotNormalised for each NDC no 11-digit code can be made of, of a medication or of a Medication a reference resolves to, fhirr4:medicationDosageRepeated for each dosage text after the first, fhirr4:dosageElementNotCarried for each dose quantity of a dosage after its first, fhirr4:courseOfTherapyTypeNotMapped for a course of therapy's coding outside FHIR's three codes and its text where none is carried, fhirr4:expectedSupplyDurationNotInUnitOfTime for a supply duration in no unit of time, fhirr4:dateNotCarried for an authoredOn, effective[x] or dosage bound that matches no form of FHIR's date and dateTime, and fhirr4:expectedSupplyDurationBound for its comparator, at paths the source accounting carries for the other kinds or where they hold one value; for a MedicationDispense, only the reference, the note and the codings.

@graph.name: Findings: what a MedicationDispense's mapping leaves behind
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:medicationDispenseElementNotCarried for each element of a dispense no Cascade predicate carries and for a quantity or days' supply with a comparator, fhirr4:medicationNumberNotCarried for a quantity or days' supply in no decimal form, fhirr4:dispenseDaysSupplyNotInUnitOfTime for a days' supply in no UCUM unit of time, fhirr4:doseUnitCodeOutsideUcum for a quantity whose unit code is not UCUM's, and fhirr4:dateNotCarried for a whenPrepared or whenHandedOver that matches no form of FHIR's date and dateTime.

@graph.name: Findings: a dispense's prescription that names no record
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:authorizingPrescriptionNotNamed at each authorizingPrescription of a MedicationDispense that medication-dispense-prescription.rq resolves to no record.

@graph.name: Findings query: the codes of a condition or a procedure not carried
@graph.description: What condition.rq, procedure.rq, report.rq and note-or-document.rq leave behind of a code or a note's type: fhirr4:codingNotCarried for a coding with no system, a system coding-system-table.rq gives no row, or no code or a code of blanks, at its code or its system; and fhirr4:procedureCptCodeRepeated for each CPT code of a procedure after the first that differs from it, the vocabulary holding one.

@graph.name: Findings: what a lab result's mapping leaves behind
@graph.description: Reports, for an Observation lab-result-table.rq calls a lab result, fhirr4:labResultPeriodEnd for the end of its effectivePeriod, fhirr4:codingNotCarried for each coding of its code with no system, a system coding-system-table.rq gives no row, or no code, fhirr4:labResultRangeRepeated for each value of a reference range after the first, fhirr4:labResultInterpretationNotCarried for each flag in a system other than v3 ObservationInterpretation or with no code, and for an interpretation's text where none of its flags is carried, fhirr4:performerCarriedOnlyAsOneOrganizationRecord for each performer reference of a result from a server whose performers name more than one Organization, at paths the source accounting carries for the other kinds or where they hold one value.

@graph.name: Findings: a reason a value is absent that is not carried
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:absentReasonNotCarried for each coding of a lab result's dataAbsentReason outside FHIR's data absent reasons and v3 NullFlavor, or with a code its system does not define, and for each data-absent-reason extension whose code FHIR's CodeSystem does not define.

@graph.name: Findings: what a variant's mapping leaves behind
@graph.description: Reports, for an Observation variant-table.rq calls a variant, the gene or protein change an HGVS expression drops (fhirr4:variantHgvsGeneOrProtein), an expression it does not carry (fhirr4:variantHgvsNoReferenceSequence, fhirr4:variantHgvsNotCoding, fhirr4:variantHgvsRepeated), a ClinVar code that is no variation's ID or one of several (fhirr4:variantClinvarNotVariation, fhirr4:variantClinvarRepeated), a code of another system under the discrete variant element (fhirr4:variantDiscreteVariantCode), and a gene coding without a display or one of several symbols (fhirr4:variantGeneWithoutSymbol, fhirr4:variantGeneRepeated); and fhirr4:variantNotPresent for an Observation it calls a variant that is not a record.

@graph.name: Findings: what a variant interpretation's mapping leaves behind
@graph.description: Reports, for an Observation variant-interpretation-table.rq calls a diagnostic implication, fhirr4:interpretationClassification for a classification that is none of the five ACMG/AMP answers or one of several, and fhirr4:interpretationVariantLink for each derivedFrom reference, or for the code where there is none (a derivedFrom with no reference is none), when derivedFrom does not name exactly one variant record and nothing else; and fhirr4:performerCarriedOnlyAsOneOrganizationRecord for each performer reference when its performers name no organization record, or more than one.

@graph.name: FHIR R4 JSON source accounting
@graph.description: The file the crate names as bridge:sourceAccounting: one bridge:PathEntry for each path a mapping in in/sparql/ reads and each path the judged inputs carry, written as JSON Pointer reference tokens from the record, at every place a resource stands in one: the record under the resource envelope, /resource under the Bundle envelope, and /contained under either; each with its verdict against in/sparql/.

@graph.name: Findings: an Organization whose record another Organization gives the version of
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:duplicateOrganizationNotCarried for an Organization organization.rq makes a record whose version another Organization of the document gives, as organization.rq picks it, when it holds a name, an identifier or an address that version lacks, as organization-table.rq lists them. Its value is the identifier the record is named by, typed by its system.

@graph.name: Findings: a DocumentReference of a C-CDA document, and attachment data not read
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:documentReferenceToCcdaDocument at the format code of a DocumentReference whose content is a structured C-CDA document, fhirr4:attachmentDataNotRead at each report or note attachment whose content is not read (by URL only, or data that is no text/plain or text/html the Bridge decodes), fhirr4:textAttachmentNotCarried at each text attachment after the one carried, and fhirr4:performerCarriedOnlyAsOneOrganizationRecord at each performer or author reference of a report or note whose performers or authors name more than one Organization.

@graph.name: Findings: a report's result that names no record
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:reportResultNotNamed at each result reference of a DiagnosticReport that report-results.rq resolves to no record.

@graph.name: Findings: a narrative not carried
@graph.description: Reports fhirr4:narrative at each text div narrative-text.rq does not carry: any resource's but a report's or a note's, and theirs where a text/plain or text/html attachment is carried instead.

@graph.name: Findings: a patient reference in a document from no known server
@graph.description: A finding for each patient or subject reference of a mapped resource written relative to a server, in a document supplied no cascade:serverBaseUrl: it names no record, and record.rq writes no link for it.

@graph.name: Findings: a patient reference that names no record
